title.zh: 将布拉干省 Polo市镇 Polo 小学的名称变更为Pio 巴伦苏埃拉小学的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Polo Elementary School in the Municipality of Polo, Province of Bulacan, to Pio Valenzuela Elementary School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Polo Elementary School in the Municipality of Polo, Province of Bulacan, to Pio Valenzuela Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Polo tại Đô thị Polo, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường Tiểu học Pio Valenzuela
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Polo ในเทศบาล Polo จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pio Valenzuela
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Polo di Kotamadya Polo, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Pio Valenzuela
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Polo di Perbandaran Polo, Wilayah Bulacan kepada Sekolah Rendah Pio Valenzuela

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2489_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Polo Elementary School in the Municipality of Polo, Province of Bulacan, is hereby changed to Pio Valenzuela Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
